svg.title: DeepSeek-V4.1 ROM — coordinate floorplan snapshot
svg.desc: INTERIM GEOMETRY • old elements and hub reservations • current rebase pending. Drawn from v41_w18/die_floorplan_ch8.64.json; actual cluster and hub coordinates are retained. Orange: ROM clusters. Purple: dedicated hub. Blue: VM. Green: HBM service reservations. The snapshot slot count does not qualify current weight ownership, BF16 columns or complete timing. Replace with the current mapped-element / plus-hub assembly after contextual SS/FF and route checks.
